issues.description: Patch diff header uses absolute build-machine paths (--- /storage/Users/currentUser/builds/imagemagick-7.1.2.29.orig/configure) instead of the standard relative a/b path format used by patches 0001 and 0002 (--- a/config/config.guess). This inconsistency suggests the patch may have been created manually rather than via refresh-patch --auto, which would be a violation of R3. The patch content itself is correct (umask 077→022).
issues.fix_suggestion: Regenerate the patch using refresh-patch --auto to produce standard --- a/configure / +++ b/configure relative-path headers, consistent with patches 0001 and 0002.

issues.description: manifest.yaml uses field name 'software' instead of 'name' as specified in code style rule 14 (which shows 'name: zlib'). CI scripts or other tooling that parse the manifest may expect the 'name' field and fail to find it.
issues.fix_suggestion: Rename 'software' to 'name' to match rule 14 specification, or verify that all CI parsing scripts accept 'software' as an alias for 'name'.

issues.description: package_type = "library" in conanfile.py is inconsistent with commands.json type = "tool". ImageMagick provides both libraries (MagickCore, MagickWand, Magick++) and CLI tools (magick, convert, identify). The conanfile.py package_info() does not declare cpp_info.bindirs, so CLI tools are not exposed to consumers, yet commands.json declares them. This semantic mismatch may confuse downstream users about the package's primary purpose.
issues.fix_suggestion: Either (a) add cpp_info.bindirs = ["bin"] to package_info() to expose CLI executables and make commands.json consistent, or (b) if this is primarily a library package, verify whether commands.json is actually needed. If ImageMagick CLI tools are a secondary output, consider documenting this in notes.md.

issues.description: patch_description values do not include the 4-digit sequence number prefix shown in rule 12 example (e.g., '0001 build aux config.guess'). Actual descriptions are 'Add HarmonyOS detection to config.guess (E007)' etc. — descriptive but deviate from the example format.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider prefixing descriptions with the sequence number for consistency, e.g., '0001 add HarmonyOS detection to config.guess (E007)'.

issues.description: Comment '# Fix umask 077 issue on HMDFS (E011)' above the CONFIG_SHELL environment variable setting is misleading. The actual umask 077→022 fix is in patch 0003-configure-umask.patch, not in the CONFIG_SHELL=/bin/sh environment definition. CONFIG_SHELL ensures a predictable shell for configure, which is a separate concern.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the comment to clarify its purpose, e.g., '# Ensure consistent shell behavior for configure on HMDFS' and note that the umask fix is handled by patch 0003.

issues.description: Comment '# Also run the binary directly to verify --version works' is inaccurate. The test_imagemagick binary does not accept a --version argument and does not parse argv. Running it without arguments executes the image creation and dimension verification test, not a --version check.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the comment to: '# Also run the test binary directly to verify it exits 0 on success' or similar accurate description.

summary:
Audit of imagemagick/7.1.2.29 Conan recipe PASSED — no P0 or P1 blocking issues found.

P0 Deceptive Behavior — ALL PASS:
- R34 Empty shell test: test_imagemagick.c calls real MagickWand API (MagickWandGenesis, NewMagickWand, MagickSetSize, MagickReadImage, MagickGetImageWidth/Height, DestroyMagickWand, MagickWandTerminus). Not a printf-only stub.
- R9 Fake pass: test_package/conanfile.py test() calls cmake.test() and self.run(bin_path). No pass/exit 0/workaround.
- Fake sha256: 'b05924ad...' is valid 64-char hex, not all-zeros/all-f/short.
- Fake status: manifest.yaml status='built' (honestly not published). Consistent with notes.md.
- R8 __OHOS__ stub: Patch 0001 adds #elif defined(__OHOS__) with real LIBC detection logic. No empty stubs.
- R19 Manual binary: No .so/.a/.o files in PR.
- R40 Deep adaptation: ImageMagick is CPU-based image processing (no GPU/rendering). Patches handle platform detection + umask. Test covers real API.

P1 Recipe Correctness — ALL PASS:
- R6: Generated files (configure, config.guess, config.sub) modified via patches/ directory with apply_conandata_patches — rule-compliant approach.
- R26: ImageMagick is not a system-name library; N/A. Default shared=False with --enable-static is good practice.
- R32: No '== Linux' checks that miss OHOS. Uses AutotoolsToolchain.
- R33: Uses Conan Environment API (env.define, env.vars, save_script). No bare os.environ.
- R34: Real API test (covered in P0).
- Version: 7.1.2.29 for first adaptation (upstream tag 7.1.2-29). Correct.
- Dependency format: self.requires('name/version') — Conan 2.x correct.
- Template placeholders: No TODO/FIXME/XXX/(请填写) found in any file.

P2/P3 (non-blocking): 3 P2 warnings (patch 0003 absolute paths vs R3; manifest field 'software' vs 'name'; package_type=library vs commands.json type=tool) and 3 P3 minor issues (patch_description missing sequence prefix; misleading CONFIG_SHELL comment; misleading test_package --version comment).
